Row.Text: Sui Dynasty -- The Four Seas Connected

营都兴业：首都+2 [ICON_Citizen] 人口并获得免费粮仓；可在拥有运河的城市开展“大举迁都”，最多两次。[NEWLINE]开渠通漕：研究“工程”后解锁运河和堤坝。建造军营、{LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_NAME}、运河和堤坝时+100% [ICON_Production] 生产力，建成后获得一名建造者并触发文化炸弹；建成运河另获+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 商路容量和一名商人。[NEWLINE]舟楫相望：国内商路+2 [ICON_Food] 食物、+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力、+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币，目的城市每座水利区域或仓廪再提供同等收益。外国通往本方城市的每条商路，为目的城市提供+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币、+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化，陆海均适用。[NEWLINE]泽润九州：泛滥平原上的改良设施+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化；境内泛滥平原为相邻单元格提供+1魅力。城市每座位于惊艳单元格的{LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_NAME}和堤坝+10%余粮。[NEWLINE]万国来朝：占领其他主要文明的原始 [ICON_Capital] 首都时，获得该文明的特色能力。

Imperial Seat: The Capital gains +2 Population and a free Granary. May relocate the Capital to a city with a Canal, up to twice.[NEWLINE]Grand Works: Engineering unlocks Canals and Dams. +100% Production toward Encampments, {LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_NAME}, Canals and Dams; completing one grants a Builder and triggers a Culture Bomb. Each completed Canal also grants +1 Trade Route capacity and a Trader.[NEWLINE]Flourishing Waterways: Domestic routes gain +2 Food, +2 Production and +2 Gold, plus the same yields per hydraulic district or Canglin in the destination. Foreign incoming routes grant the destination +2 Gold and +1 Culture, by land or sea.[NEWLINE]Fertile Realm: Improved Floodplains gain +1 Culture. Owned Floodplains provide +1 Appeal to adjacent tiles. Each {LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_NAME} or Dam on a Breathtaking tile grants its city +10% Growth.[NEWLINE]Tribute of Nations: Conquering another major civilization’s original Capital grants its civilization ability.
隋朝中世纪特色海军远程单位，取代护卫舰，“雇佣兵”市政解锁，使用护卫舰的基础数值与资源需求。[NEWLINE]楼船水师：位于海岸地形或己方已建成运河两格以内时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，条件不叠加。[NEWLINE]护航朝贡：四格以内的己方商人免遭劫掠。

Medieval naval ranged unit unique to Sui, replacing the Frigate. Unlocked at Mercenaries; uses Frigate base stats and resource requirements.[NEWLINE]Tower Fleet: +5 Strength on Coast or within 2 tiles of a completed friendly Canal; conditions do not stack.[NEWLINE]Tributary Convoy: Friendly Traders within 4 tiles are protected from plundering.
位于海岸地形或己方已建成运河两格以内时+5战斗力，条件不叠加。
+5 Strength on Coast or within 2 tiles of a completed friendly Canal; conditions do not stack.
处于五牙战舰四格内，免遭劫掠。
Protected from plundering within 4 tiles of a Wuya Warship.
